copy.tagline_en: Design reliable long-running workflows and distributed transactions

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 Temporal 的编排模式帮你设计持久化工作流:把 workflow 与 activity 分工、用 saga 模式处理分布式事务、管理状态,并指出确定性与幂等相关的常见写法问题。
howto.when: 当你在构建长时间运行的流程、分布式事务或微服务编排时,它会接管并给出设计建议;简单 CRUD 或纯数据管道不在其范围内。

howto.what_en: Claude will design durable Temporal workflows with you: separating workflow from activity, applying saga compensation for distributed transactions, managing state, and flagging determinism and idempotency pitfalls.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build long-running processes, distributed transactions, or microservice orchestration with Temporal. Simple CRUD and pure data pipelines are out of scope.
